lines.reason: Only formed fold: plate (2) to flange (4), about 90 deg (incl 89.9). Perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% put the label point on the outer-skin arc apex. Nearest-point distance to the line is 0.01-0.10 mm at 10 stations. The line runs t 0-58.43 mm and the fold points run t -0.34 to 58.54 mm, so coverage is about 99%. It is parallel to the fold in the face-on, inside and side close-ups and in all global views.
